adoption_rule: LOCAL_PIT -> chronological OOS/WFO -> calibration -> ablation -> robustness -> frozen holdout -> adoption
missingness_rule: missing/unavailable/unknown/delayed/source_failed are not TRUE_ZERO and must not be silently converted into observed zero

feature_set_variants.TEAM_PLUS_STARTER: BASELINE_TEAM_STATE + PIT-safe starter history and starter-derived gaps
feature_set_variants.TEAM_PLUS_BULLPEN: BASELINE_TEAM_STATE + lagged bullpen/workload and source-supported relief quality
feature_set_variants.FULL_NO_PIT_CONTEXT: all constructed non-context families; excludes lineup/weather/context flags
feature_set_variants.FULL_VALIDATED_ENSEMBLE: all constructed families including explicitly PIT-safe context when enabled

variant_selection_rule: Select feature sets by chronological OOS/WFO evidence, PIT eligibility, missingness/coverage, calibration, robustness, computational cost and holdout behavior. Do not prefer larger feature sets by default.
runtime_truth: The prediction artifact's feature_set_id and feature_schema_hash are authoritative for the exact columns used.

feature_variant_screen.decision_rule: Screen on newest chronological holdout only after chronological model-validation selection; no auto-adoption. Any winner must repeat full WFO/OOS + calibration + ablation + robustness + frozen holdout.
